■ Stage Direction
Start: pause to steel one's resolve

...? ...Ah, what?!
Are you seriously saying... the two of us should buy time...?

It's all right, it's all right~.
I am right here with you~. Everything will be fine~...
Provisional Trainer...

"Yeah... Ryan really is cool.
She's always looked out for everyone, since way back... and she's still so humble."

I'm not gonna cry, obviously! ...All right, fine.
I want to be useful, too... so I'll give it my best...!

If it was just talking, maybe I could do it... but while looking at all those fans?
...I'm sorry. I just don't have the confidence...

Wait, Maki-chan...? Isn't that girl Dober-san?
Is this a puppet show...? What an unusual concept.

I need your help.
All we have to do is talk just like we usually do... okay~?

Yes. Inexperienced though we may be, we are still members of the Mejiro family.
I believe the fans would enjoy this much more than simply being made to wait.

Wait, haven't those two not debuted yet...?
Is this supposed to be like an opening act?

By bringing the puppet into play, the eyes on Mejiro Dober would be dispersed...
and she could escape their gaze by speaking through the puppet.

Yes~... *Achoo!* 
Phew~... It almost feels like it might start snowing~.

...I understand that this is an ordeal for you, Dober.
However, I certainly won't be able to speak well on my own.

It's not that...! Bright, you're late...
Wait, isn't that puppet... "Maki-chan"? Why do you have it?

...*Sigh*, I see. You were late because you were getting her ready.
The others have already headed to the venue, so let's catch the train after them.

...Suddenly, I notice. Mejiro Bright's hand, as she encourages Mejiro Dober,
is trembling, ever so slightly.

Mejiro Bright loves the Mejiro family more than anyone. With her here,
there's no way she'd let its name be tarnished. Above all else—
..."I'm Maki-chan. Nice to meet you..."

The day before the Debut Race. I had arranged to meet with Mejiro Bright and the others
to observe a Mejiro family event, but...

Yeah... "Hey, no, you've got it wrong! I'm Maki-chan!
How many times are you gonna mix that up?!"

Mejiro Bright didn't show up at the appointed meeting time...
After about 30 minutes of awkward silence with Mejiro Dober—

Yes, this is "Maki-chan"~. Since this is a special occasion,
I thought she should watch Ryan-oneesama and the others' heroic figures with us~.

Let's explain the situation to the fans and ask them to wait.
I'm sure they'll understand. Though they might get bored...

That might be true, but... it's still impossible for me.
I mean—

McQueen-sama, Ryan-oneesama, and everyone else...
would handle this with flexibility and grace. If so, then we must—

The suggestion I made to the two was to conduct the talk
with the puppet Mejiro Bright had brought between them.

...Still, I cannot force you.
Very well, I shall go alone—

Indeed~. Everyone in the Mejiro family has been wonderful since they were little...
We hope to become just like them someday, don't we, Bel-chan~?

...B-But... If I try all that and still mess up completely,
and drag the Mejiro family's name through the mud...

Hehehe...! Those two are so adorable~♪
I see, so it's a comedy sketch routine!

Yes. Traffic is completely gridlocked due to the sudden snow...
Running would be dangerous, so they're apparently heading here by train now.

But won't that mean they won't make it in time for the start...?
It begins in five minutes, and there are so many fans here...

Right~? We'll get to see all their gorgeous faces in just a bit...
Ah, I need to burn this into my eyes and memory...!

Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone!
Leave the rest to us—!
..."Maki-chan"~?

...I understand.
Well then... shall we have a chat together~?♪

...It is just as Provisional Trainer says. I will be right by your side.
I certainly won't let Dober burst into tears~.

Because she has resolved to be the one supporting the Mejiro family next.
No matter the circumstance, she seeks to carry out her ideals. In that case—

—And so, Ryan-oneesama took my hand
and ran alongside me. She was ever so dashing~.
—In order to become the Mejiro family's new light...!

—Talk as a puppet?!
Doesn't that actually make it way harder...?!

—I wonder what kind of stories they'll share with us...
It's so rare for all of them to be gathered together...!

Afterward, the entrance of today's main stars brought the venue to an even greater fever pitch.
Mejiro Bright and Dober had successfully added brilliant color to the event.

...No way! In front of that many people...
I... I can't speak...!

—Wait, McQueen and the others
haven't arrived yet...?!

Whether it was a prophecy or not... it began snowing on our way to the venue.
The sudden shift in weather, like plunging back into midwinter, caused disruptions everywhere—

—Oh my, is it just the two of you?
My, what good friends you are~.

—Both Dober and Bright... are quite dependable, aren't they?
We owe them a great debt. Still... why the puppet?

—A pleasure to meet you all~♪
My name is Mejiro Bright. And...
